resources.string: When enabled, Guardian shows an ongoing notification. This app does not block Android system controls.
Lockdown is active. Use the owner unlock button or send UNLOCKDOWN.

For the optional accessibility helper, open Accessibility settings and enable Guardian. Draw over other apps is optional and is not required for the visible Emergency Lock Screen. Guardian does not dismiss or obscure Android system dialogs.
Optional Guardian helper. It does not inspect screen contents or interfere with system controls.
Tap to view protection status and owner unlock options.

Device Protected — Emergency Lock Active

تم تفعيل وضع الحماية — الجهاز مقفل

This screen does not replace the Android lock screen. Verify your device identity to exit, or send UNLOCKDOWN from an authorized number.
Authenticate to close the Emergency Lock Screen.
No secure screen lock is configured. Set a PIN, pattern, or password in Android settings first.
Lockdown enabled. The phone was locked if device-admin permission is active.
Secret code (the trigger SMS must contain it)
Trusted numbers — allowed to send commands (one per line). The first receives SIM-change and low-battery alerts.
Allow anyone with the PIN (anonymous access)
PIN — lets you command the phone from another handset by including it in the message
Turn ON mobile data when triggered
Location set to “Allow all the time”
Choose “Allow all the time” for background location access.
Allows Guardian to lock the phone remotely. You can deactivate this any time in Android security settings.

Shizuku lets this app enable mobile data and location without root. Install Shizuku, enable Developer options and Wireless debugging, then start Shizuku and grant access here. It must be restarted after reboot.
✅ Permissions OK. Text your secret code to locate this phone. Set location to “Allow all the time” for background use.
Shizuku: not running. Tap “How to start”.
Shizuku: running but not authorized. Tap “Request access”.
Uninstall protection: ON. You can also send your code followed by LOCK.
Uninstall protection: OFF. Enable it to prevent uninstalling while device admin is active.
